overall: The checkout flow is unusable on mobile: the submit button is off-screen below the fold and cannot be reached, which blocks purchase. Lower-severity polish issues are also present.

findings.title: Checkout submit button is unreachable on mobile
findings.description: On the mobile viewport the 'Place order' button renders below a fixed footer and cannot be scrolled into view, so the purchase cannot be completed.
findings.suggestion: Remove the fixed footer overlap or reserve bottom padding equal to the footer height so the CTA is reachable.

findings.title: Order summary contrast fails WCAG AA
findings.description: The order summary subtotal text uses a grey on white that falls below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio on desktop.
findings.suggestion: Use the `--color-text-strong` token for the subtotal.

findings.title: Promo-code field lacks a visible label
findings.description: The promo-code input relies on placeholder text only, which disappears on focus.
findings.suggestion: Add a persistent visible label above the field.

findings.title: Inconsistent button corner radius
findings.description: Secondary buttons use 4px radius while primaries use 8px on desktop.
findings.suggestion: Use a single radius token across buttons.

notReviewed: route /receipt (no preview deployment matched the expected revision)
